// Gleiches Muster wie Paper-Trading-Review/Trading-Entscheidungszentrale: Nav-Aufruf INLINE vor
// diesem Node, Trigger-Daten per Namens-Lookup, POST-Fallthrough referenziert den Code-Node VOR
// dem Postgres-Node (nie den Postgres-Node selbst).
let fromPost = null;
try { fromPost = $('POST: Review normalisieren + SQL bauen').first().json; } catch (e) { fromPost = null; }
const isFromPost = fromPost && fromPost.mode === 'detail_nach_post' && fromPost.news_id !== undefined;

let newsId;
if (isFromPost) {
  newsId = fromPost.news_id;
} else {
  const trigger = $('Webhook GET (Ansicht)').first().json;
  newsId = (trigger.query && trigger.query.id) ? Number(trigger.query.id) : null;
}

let sql;
if (newsId) {
  sql = `SELECT ni.id, ni.title, ni.url, ni.source, ni.published_at, ni.status, ni.discarded_reason,
      ni.article_text, ni.raw_content,
      na.id AS assessment_id, na.relevant, na.wirkungsrichtung, na.wirkung_staerke, na.konfidenz,
      na.relevance_confidence, na.betroffene_ticker_json, na.betroffene_sektoren_json,
      na.ticker_begruendung, na.wirkungs_begruendung, na.news_kategorie, na.confirmation_status,
      nrn.urteil AS bisheriges_urteil, nrn.kommentar AS bisheriger_kommentar, nrn.reviewed_at AS notiz_reviewed_at,
      nff.id AS false_negative_flag_id, nff.status AS false_negative_status, nff.grund AS false_negative_grund
    FROM trading.news_items ni
    LEFT JOIN trading.v_news_latest_assessment vla ON vla.news_id = ni.id
    LEFT JOIN trading.news_assessments na ON na.id = vla.assessment_id
    LEFT JOIN trading.news_review_notes nrn ON nrn.news_id = ni.id
    LEFT JOIN trading.news_false_negative_flags nff ON nff.news_id = ni.id
    WHERE ni.id = ${newsId};`;
} else {
  // Liste-Modus: EIN SELECT mit fuenf JSON-Spalten (eine je Kategorie) - gleicher Trick wie
  // Paper-Trading-Review, vermeidet Mehrfach-Statements in einem Postgres-Node.
  sql = `SELECT
      (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) FROM (
         SELECT ni.id AS news_id, ni.title, ni.source, ni.published_at,
                na.betroffene_ticker_json, na.wirkungsrichtung, na.konfidenz, na.relevance_confidence
         FROM trading.news_items ni
         JOIN trading.v_news_latest_assessment vla ON vla.news_id = ni.id
         JOIN trading.news_assessments na ON na.id = vla.assessment_id
         LEFT JOIN trading.news_review_notes nrn ON nrn.news_id = ni.id
         WHERE vla.relevance = true AND vla.confirmation_status = 'unconfirmed' AND nrn.id IS NULL
           AND (na.relevance_confidence IS NULL OR na.relevance_confidence >= 50)
         ORDER BY na.created_at DESC LIMIT 15
       ) t) AS zu_bestaetigen,
      (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) FROM (
         SELECT ni.id AS news_id, ni.title, ni.source, ni.published_at,
                na.betroffene_ticker_json, na.wirkungsrichtung, na.konfidenz, na.relevance_confidence
         FROM trading.news_items ni
         JOIN trading.v_news_latest_assessment vla ON vla.news_id = ni.id
         JOIN trading.news_assessments na ON na.id = vla.assessment_id
         LEFT JOIN trading.news_review_notes nrn ON nrn.news_id = ni.id
         WHERE vla.confirmation_status = 'unconfirmed' AND nrn.id IS NULL
           AND na.relevance_confidence IS NOT NULL AND na.relevance_confidence < 50
         ORDER BY na.created_at DESC LIMIT 15
       ) t) AS unsicher,
      (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) FROM (
         SELECT ni.id AS news_id, ni.title, ni.source, ni.published_at, na.wirkungs_begruendung
         FROM trading.news_items ni
         JOIN trading.v_news_latest_assessment vla ON vla.news_id = ni.id
         JOIN trading.news_assessments na ON na.id = vla.assessment_id
         LEFT JOIN trading.news_review_notes nrn ON nrn.news_id = ni.id
         LEFT JOIN trading.news_false_negative_flags nff ON nff.news_id = ni.id
         WHERE vla.relevance = false AND vla.confirmation_status = 'unconfirmed'
           AND nrn.id IS NULL AND nff.id IS NULL
         ORDER BY na.created_at DESC LIMIT 10
       ) t) AS ki_verworfen,
      (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) FROM (
         SELECT ni.id AS news_id, ni.title, ni.source, ni.published_at, ni.discarded_reason
         FROM trading.news_items ni
         WHERE ni.status = 'filtered'
         ORDER BY ni.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 10
       ) t) AS vorfilter_verworfen,
      (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) FROM (
         SELECT nff.id AS flag_id, nff.news_id, ni.title, nff.status, nff.grund, nff.created_at
         FROM trading.news_false_negative_flags nff
         JOIN trading.news_items ni ON ni.id = nff.news_id
         WHERE nff.status IN ('possible_false_negative', 'filter_revision_required')
         ORDER BY nff.created_at DESC LIMIT 10
       ) t) AS gemeldete_false_negatives,

      -- Vorfilter-Wirksamkeit (sql/073): nur Summenzahlen aus den letzten 7 Tagen, keine
      -- Einzelartikel - Ergaenzung zur (weiterhin leeren) Einzelartikel-Liste oben.
      (SELECT json_build_object(
         'anzahl_laeufe', count(*),
         'geprueft', COALESCE(sum(total_artikel_geprueft), 0),
         'durchgelassen', COALESCE(sum(total_durchgelassen), 0),
         'hart_ausgeschlossen', COALESCE(sum(total_hart_ausgeschlossen), 0),
         'soft_noise_ausgeschlossen', COALESCE(sum(total_soft_noise_ausgeschlossen), 0),
         'kein_treffer', COALESCE(sum(total_kein_treffer), 0),
         'letzter_lauf', max(run_at)
       ) FROM trading.news_prefilter_runs WHERE run_at > now() - interval '7 days') AS vorfilter_wirksamkeit,

      -- Historischer Filter-Wirksamkeit (Workflow 16 Ticker-Matching + news_match_exclusions):
      -- aktive Regeln + kumulierte/letzte-7-Tage-Treffer, damit sichtbar wird, wie viele
      -- teure KI-Aufrufe (Workflow 16b) durch bereits bestaetigte Lernkandidaten vermieden wurden.
      (SELECT json_build_object(
         'aktive_regeln', (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.news_match_exclusions WHERE aktiv = TRUE),
         'treffer_gesamt', COALESCE((SELECT sum(hit_count) FROM trading.news_match_exclusions WHERE aktiv = TRUE), 0),
         'treffer_7_tage', COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM trading.news_match_exclusion_hits WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND dry_run = FALSE), 0),
         'stichprobe_7_tage', COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM trading.news_match_exclusion_hits WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND dry_run = TRUE), 0),
         'offene_lernkandidaten', (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.news_match_exclusion_candidates WHERE status = 'pending'),
         'letzter_treffer', (SELECT max(last_hit_at) FROM trading.news_match_exclusions WHERE aktiv = TRUE),
         'ticker_matched', (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.historical_news WHERE ticker_match_status = 'matched'),
         'ticker_ambiguous', (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.historical_news WHERE ticker_match_status = 'ambiguous'),
         'ticker_ausgeschlossen', (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.historical_news WHERE ticker_match_status = 'none')
       )) AS historischer_filter_wirksamkeit;`;
}

return [{ json: { sql, mode: newsId ? 'detail' : 'liste', news_id: newsId } }];
